text.p: Following are some of the main stories in Dutch newspapers today. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
HET FINANCIEELE DAGBLAD
- Van Lanschot Bankiers is seeking an insurance partner to broaden its operations as a financial services company. (p1)
- Dutch retail sector is not enthusiastic about the introduction of the single European currency, the Euro. (p1)
- PTT Telecom is putting all its energy into expanding its mobile telephony as soon as possible. (p3)
- Tools and machine maker Nedschroef reports 1996 net dropped by 100,000 guilders to 12.9 million guilders. (p1)
- Hagemeyer subsidiary, wholesaler Ceteco, is to finance its expansion by an issue of new shares. (p3)
- Dutch medium-sized companies not listed on the stock exchange are cheap according to consultancy Moret Ernst & Young report. (p5)
- Insurer Aegon's banking subsidiary Labouchere's 1996 net profit boosted by private sector. (p15)
- Market maker AOT doubles net profit in 1997 Q1 to Dfl 10.7 million. (p15)
DE VOLKSKRANT
- Cabinet is to make less polluting cars cheaper next year. (p1)
- Companies are fighting to hire young, well-educated but pliable personnel. (p1)
- Save-as-you-earn scheme is still very popular, with a total deposit of Dfl 9.1 bn. (p2)
- Philips Electronics' vacuum cleaner plant in Hoogeveen starts strike against reorganisation plans. (p29)
DE TELEGRAAF
- Ajax Amsterdam loses 2-1 against Italy's Juventus in first match of the Champions League final. (p1)
- Royal Dutch/Shell starts smart pump experiment in the U.S. with robot to automatically fill up cars at filling stations. (p1)
- Prices erosion on the German market will pressure cable maker NKF results by 30 to 45 percent this year. (p33)
- Estate agents group Match Makelaars seeks to conquer the market slowly. (p33)
TROUW
- Province of Zuid-Limburg gets Dfl 141 million from the European Commission to improve environment and to boost competitive power. (p3)
- Money's Delichamp, a joint-venture of Dutch mushroom firm Heveco and Canada's Money Mushroom Ltd, is to boost the mushroom's image in Europe. (p8)
ALGEMEEN DAGBLAD
- Shipyard Koninklijke Schelde books 3.4 million guilders loss in 1996 against its own expectations. (p11)
--Amsterdam newsdesk +31-20-504-5000
